## Instagram Post Scraper

### How it works

This workflow exposes a webhook that accepts Instagram post URLs, sends them to the CoreClaw Instagram Post Scraper Worker, and retrieves structured post data including captions, likes, comments, and media URLs. It then aggregates engagement statistics and returns the results to the webhook caller.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Webhook Trigger URL and HTTP method according to how the workflow will be called.
- Add your CoreClaw API key as the CORECLAW_API_KEY environment variable in n8n.
- Ensure the incoming webhook body contains a urls array with Instagram post URLs.
- Test the workflow with a sample Instagram post URL.

### Customization

You can adjust the input format to accept different request body structures, modify the result parsing to extract additional fields, or extend the aggregation step with custom metrics such as engagement rate or top-performing posts.

## Receive and prepare input

Starts the workflow from a webhook request and extracts the Instagram post URLs from the incoming request body.

## Run CoreClaw Worker and parse results

Calls the CoreClaw Instagram Post Scraper Worker with the provided URLs, then converts the API response into clean post objects for downstream processing.

## Summarize and return results

Calculates aggregate metrics such as total posts, likes, comments, and average likes per post, then sends the final response back to the webhook caller.
